metadata.description: Swift skill collection focused on package documentation architecture, Swift library dependency audits, SwiftPM architecture guidance, SwiftPM library distillation, SwiftUI and UIKit architecture guidance, Swift Concurrency guidance, Swift Testing patterns, SwiftData patterns, Core Data patterns, CloudKit patterns, Keychain patterns, CryptoKit patterns, Certificate Trust patterns, AuthenticationServices patterns, Accessibility patterns, Focus Engine patterns, interface writing, Figma-to-SwiftUI translation, SwiftUI patterns, SwiftUI performance, SwiftUI design, WidgetKit implementation, WidgetKit design, TipKit patterns, RelevanceKit patterns, Swift Charts patterns, Xcode Instruments patterns, MetricKit patterns, Xcode localization workflows, App Intents, ActivityKit, App Clips, UserNotifications/APNs, StoreKit, WebKit, MapKit, PhotoKit, AVKit, MusicKit, PDFKit, PaperKit, PencilKit, Contacts, EventKit, HealthKit, PassKit, WeatherKit, FinanceKit, Foundation Models, Core ML, MLX Swift, Vision, Natural Language, Translation, Speech, Foundation URLSession, Network.framework, BackgroundTasks, DeviceCheck/App Attest, CryptoTokenKit, AccessorySetupKit, Core Bluetooth, Core NFC, Core Motion, DockKit, SensorKit, AudioAccessoryKit, HomeKit/MatterSupport, CallKit/PushKit, GroupActivities/SharePlay, CarPlay, AppMigrationKit, AdAttributionKit, AlarmKit, BrowserEngineKit, EnergyKit, PermissionKit, GameKit, SpriteKit, SceneKit, TabletopKit, RealityKit/ARKit, SwiftLint, iOS Simulator, Apple-platform release engineering, macOS SwiftPM app packaging, and broad Swift language / API baselines
